label: Beholder A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The original floating beholder: an irregular dark brown leathery ridged head with a large central vivid green eye under heavy folded brown eyelids. Four short thick curved stalks around the upper head end in small green eyes with pale ivory rims. A narrow open mouth beneath the central eye has small ivory teeth and a reddish interior, with thin ochre-gold hanging strands beneath the jaw. Several long slender dark gray tentacles descend and spread from the underside, ending in tapered vivid green tips. Preserve the exact native tentacle count, paths and lengths in each view, the heavy dark brown head, small stalk eyes and dark tonal weight. No legs, hands, wings, horns, clothing, armor, invented jewelry or extra appendages. Green tentacle tips change through native palettes; eyes, brown head, dark shafts, teeth and ochre strands stay protected. Preserve every thin feature with clear material boundaries.
